chapterInfo.content:
17
Suntiduatoɔ
1Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: Ɛdane sɛ deɛn ara a, suntiduatoɔ bɛba deɛ, nanso deɛ ɛnam ne so bɛba no nnue! 2#Mat 18.6-7 Anka ɛyɛ ma no sɛ wɔde ayuyammoɔ kyekyere ne kɔn mu kɔto no twene ɛpo mu sene sɛ ɔbɛto nketewa yi mu baako suntidua.
Bɔne fakyɛ
3 # Mat 18.15 Monhwɛ mo ho yie! Na sɛ wo nua fom a, ka n’anim; na sɛ ɔsakyera n’adwene a, fa kyɛ no! 4#Mat 18.21-22 Na sɛ ɔfom wo mprɛnson da koro, na ɔsane ba wo nkyɛn mprɛnson ka sɛ: Masakyera m’adwene a, fa kyɛ no! 5#Mar 9.24 Na asomafoɔ no see Awurade sɛ: To yɛn gyidie mu!
Gyidie mu tumi
6 # Mat 17.20; 21.21 Na Awurade se: Sɛ mowɔ gyidie sɛ sinapi fua a, anka mobɛka akyerɛ akyee yi sɛ: Wo nhini ntutu na kɔtim ɛpo mu! Na ɛbɛtie mo.
Nokorɛdie
7 Mo mu hwan na ɔwɔ akoa a ɔfuntum asase anaasɛ ɔhwɛ mmoa, na ɔfiri afuom ba fie a, ɔbɛse no sɛ: Bɛsene ntɛm kɔtena adidiiɛ? 8Na ɔrense no sɛ: Siesie deɛ mɛdie, na bɔ abɔsoɔ bɛsom me, na mennidi na mennom ansa, na akyire yi no, wo nso woakɔdidi na woanom? 9Ɔbɛda akoa no ase sɛ wayɛ deɛ wɔahyɛ no no? 10Saa ara na mo nso sɛ moyɛ deɛ wɔahyɛ mo nyinaa a, monka sɛ: Yɛyɛ nkoa a mfasoɔ nni yɛn so; yɛayɛ deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ.
Akwatafoɔ du no ayaresa
11 # Luka 9.51; 13.22 Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔrekɔ Yerusalem no, ɔfaa Samaria ne Galilea. 12#Lew 13.45-46 Na ɔrekɔ akuraa bi aseɛ no, mmarima du bi a wɔyɛ akwatafoɔ hyiaa no a wɔgyinagyina akyirikyiri, 13na wɔmaa wɔn nne so sɛ: Owura Yesu, hu yɛn mmɔbɔ! 14#Luka 5.14; Lew 14.2-3 Na ɔhunuu wɔn no, ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ mfa mo ho nkɔkyerɛ asɔfoɔ. Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔrekorɔ no, wɔn ho fiiɛ. 15Na wɔn mu baako hunuu sɛ ne ho asan no no, ɔsanee n’akyi de nne kɛseɛ bɛyii Onyankopɔn ayɛ, 16na ɔde n’anim butuu fam wɔ ne nan ase daa no ase. Ɔno deɛ, na ɔyɛ Samariani. 17Na Yesu buaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ du no na wɔn ho fiiɛ? Na baakron no deɛ, wɔwɔ he? 18Wɔanhunu wɔn mu biara a ɔsane de animuonyam brɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ ɔnanani yi nko? 19#Luka 7.50 Na ɔsee no sɛ: Sɔre kɔ, wo gyidie agye wo.
Nyankopɔn ahennie no ba
20 # Yoh 18.36 Na Farisifoɔ no bisaa no sɛ da bɛn na Nyankopɔn ahennie bɛba no, ɔbuaa wɔn sɛ: Nyankopɔn ahennie mma sɛ ani tua, 21#Mat 24.23 nanso wɔrenka sɛ: Hwɛ ha anaa ɛhɔ! Na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ahennie no, mo mu na ɛwɔ. 22Na ɔka kyerɛɛ asuafoɔ no sɛ: Nna bi bɛba a mobɛpɛ sɛ mobɛhunu Onipa Ba no nna no mu baako, na morenhunu. 23#Luka 21.8 Na wɔbɛse mo sɛ: Hwɛ ha! anaa: Hwɛ hɔ! a, monnkɔ, nso monnni wɔn akyi! 24#Mat 24.27 Na sɛdeɛ anyinam a ɛpa te ɔsoro ase fa hyerɛn kɔ ɔsoro ase, fa baabi no, saa ara nso na Onipa Ba no bɛyɛ ne da no mu. 25#Luka 9.22 Nanso ɛtwa sɛ ɔbɛhunu amane pii na nnɛ mma yi po no ansa.
Noa ne Lot nna ho mfatoho
26 # Mat 24.37-39 Na sɛdeɛ ɛyɛɛ Noa nna no mu no, saa ara nso na ɛbɛyɛ Onipa Ba no nna mu. 27#Gye 7.7-23 Wɔdidii, wɔnomee, wɔwaree yerenom na wɔmaa awadeɛ de kɔsii da a Noa hyɛnee adaka no mu, na nsuyire no baeɛ, na ɛbɛsɛee wɔn nyinaa. 28Sɛ nso ɛyɛɛ Lot nna mu ne no, wɔdidii, na wɔnomee, wɔtɔe, wɔtɔnee, wɔduae, na wɔtotoo adan. 29#Gye 19.15; 19.24-25 Na da a Lot firii Sodom kɔeɛ no, ogya ne sɔfe firi soro tɔeɛ, na ɛbɛsɛee wɔn nyinaa. 30Saa ara na ɛbɛyɛ ɛda a Onipa Ba no bɛyi ne ho adie no. 31#Mat 24.17-18 Da no ara, deɛ ɔwɔ ɛdan atifi na ne biribi wɔ ɛdan mu no, mma no nnsiane mmmɛfa; na deɛ ɔwɔ afuo mu no nso, mma no nnsane n’akyi. 32#Gye 19.26 Monkae Lot yere no! 33#Luka 9.24 Obiara a ɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɔgye ne kra no, ɛbɛfiri ne nsa, na obiara a ne kra bɛfiri ne nsa no ɔbɛgye no nkwa. 34Mese mo sɛ: Anadwo no, nnipa baanu bɛda mpa korɔ so; wɔbɛfa ɔbaako, na wɔagya ɔbaako. 35#Mat 24.40-41 Mmaa baanu bɛbom ayam ayuo; wɔbɛfa ɔbaako, na wɔagya ɔbaako. 36[Mmarima baanu bɛtena afuom; wɔbɛfa ɔbaako, na wɔagya ɔbaako.]#17.36 Tete Atwerɛ a wɔgye to mu binom mfa nkyekyɛmu 36 nka ho. 37#Mat 24.28 Na wɔbua see no sɛ: Ɛhe, Awurade? Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Deɛ efunu wɔ no, ɛhɔ na apɛtɛ bɛboaboa wɔn ano.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: Ɛdane sɛ deɛn ara a, suntiduatoɔ bɛba deɛ, nanso deɛ ɛnam ne so bɛba no nnue! Anka ɛyɛ ma no sɛ wɔde ayuyammoɔ kyekyere ne kɔn mu kɔto no twene ɛpo mu sene sɛ ɔbɛto nketewa yi mu baako suntidua.

Monhwɛ mo ho yie! Na sɛ wo nua fom a, ka n’anim; na sɛ ɔsakyera n’adwene a, fa kyɛ no! Na sɛ ɔfom wo mprɛnson da koro, na ɔsane ba wo nkyɛn mprɛnson ka sɛ: Masakyera m’adwene a, fa kyɛ no! Na asomafoɔ no see Awurade sɛ: To yɛn gyidie mu!

Na Awurade se: Sɛ mowɔ gyidie sɛ sinapi fua a, anka mobɛka akyerɛ akyee yi sɛ: Wo nhini ntutu na kɔtim ɛpo mu! Na ɛbɛtie mo.

Mo mu hwan na ɔwɔ akoa a ɔfuntum asase anaasɛ ɔhwɛ mmoa, na ɔfiri afuom ba fie a, ɔbɛse no sɛ: Bɛsene ntɛm kɔtena adidiiɛ? Na ɔrense no sɛ: Siesie deɛ mɛdie, na bɔ abɔsoɔ bɛsom me, na mennidi na mennom ansa, na akyire yi no, wo nso woakɔdidi na woanom? Ɔbɛda akoa no ase sɛ wayɛ deɛ wɔahyɛ no no? Saa ara na mo nso sɛ moyɛ deɛ wɔahyɛ mo nyinaa a, monka sɛ: Yɛyɛ nkoa a mfasoɔ nni yɛn so; yɛayɛ deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ.

Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔrekɔ Yerusalem no, ɔfaa Samaria ne Galilea. Na ɔrekɔ akuraa bi aseɛ no, mmarima du bi a wɔyɛ akwatafoɔ hyiaa no a wɔgyinagyina akyirikyiri, na wɔmaa wɔn nne so sɛ: Owura Yesu, hu yɛn mmɔbɔ! Na ɔhunuu wɔn no, ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ mfa mo ho nkɔkyerɛ asɔfoɔ. Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔrekorɔ no, wɔn ho fiiɛ. Na wɔn mu baako hunuu sɛ ne ho asan no no, ɔsanee n’akyi de nne kɛseɛ bɛyii Onyankopɔn ayɛ, na ɔde n’anim butuu fam wɔ ne nan ase daa no ase. Ɔno deɛ, na ɔyɛ Samariani. Na Yesu buaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ du no na wɔn ho fiiɛ? Na baakron no deɛ, wɔwɔ he? Wɔanhunu wɔn mu biara a ɔsane de animuonyam brɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ ɔnanani yi nko? Na ɔsee no sɛ: Sɔre kɔ, wo gyidie agye wo.

Na Farisifoɔ no bisaa no sɛ da bɛn na Nyankopɔn ahennie bɛba no, ɔbuaa wɔn sɛ: Nyankopɔn ahennie mma sɛ ani tua, nanso wɔrenka sɛ: Hwɛ ha anaa ɛhɔ! Na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ahennie no, mo mu na ɛwɔ. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ asuafoɔ no sɛ: Nna bi bɛba a mobɛpɛ sɛ mobɛhunu Onipa Ba no nna no mu baako, na morenhunu. Na wɔbɛse mo sɛ: Hwɛ ha! anaa: Hwɛ hɔ! a, monnkɔ, nso monnni wɔn akyi! Na sɛdeɛ anyinam a ɛpa te ɔsoro ase fa hyerɛn kɔ ɔsoro ase, fa baabi no, saa ara nso na Onipa Ba no bɛyɛ ne da no mu. Nanso ɛtwa sɛ ɔbɛhunu amane pii na nnɛ mma yi po no ansa.

Na sɛdeɛ ɛyɛɛ Noa nna no mu no, saa ara nso na ɛbɛyɛ Onipa Ba no nna mu. Wɔdidii, wɔnomee, wɔwaree yerenom na wɔmaa awadeɛ de kɔsii da a Noa hyɛnee adaka no mu, na nsuyire no baeɛ, na ɛbɛsɛee wɔn nyinaa. Sɛ nso ɛyɛɛ Lot nna mu ne no, wɔdidii, na wɔnomee, wɔtɔe, wɔtɔnee, wɔduae, na wɔtotoo adan. Na da a Lot firii Sodom kɔeɛ no, ogya ne sɔfe firi soro tɔeɛ, na ɛbɛsɛee wɔn nyinaa. Saa ara na ɛbɛyɛ ɛda a Onipa Ba no bɛyi ne ho adie no. Da no ara, deɛ ɔwɔ ɛdan atifi na ne biribi wɔ ɛdan mu no, mma no nnsiane mmmɛfa; na deɛ ɔwɔ afuo mu no nso, mma no nnsane n’akyi. Monkae Lot yere no! Obiara a ɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɔgye ne kra no, ɛbɛfiri ne nsa, na obiara a ne kra bɛfiri ne nsa no ɔbɛgye no nkwa. Mese mo sɛ: Anadwo no, nnipa baanu bɛda mpa korɔ so; wɔbɛfa ɔbaako, na wɔagya ɔbaako. Mmaa baanu bɛbom ayam ayuo; wɔbɛfa ɔbaako, na wɔagya ɔbaako. [Mmarima baanu bɛtena afuom; wɔbɛfa ɔbaako, na wɔagya ɔbaako.] Na wɔbua see no sɛ: Ɛhe, Awurade? Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Deɛ efunu wɔ no, ɛhɔ na apɛtɛ bɛboaboa wɔn ano.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
